operations.body: Please retract any use of Entries 1273 and 1276. Entry 1280 gives the authoritative correction. The first reducer mixed symbol namespaces; after that repair, profile A failed before writing and I accidentally read the stale pre-repair JSON. A fully symbol-indexed rerun exports 32 nonzero deck characters and 43,296 terms. Four direct cover evaluations reject the alleged constant.
